description: This file contains unit tests for the ProviderDAO class in the OpenMRS project, verifying provider retrieval, role handling, and retired status behaviors.

classes.name: ProviderDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing ProviderDAO methods in the OpenMRS core.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes data set before each test method.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldNotReturnRetiredProvidersIfIncludeRetiredFalse
methods.description: Tests that getProvidersByPerson excludes retired providers when includeRetired is false.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldListRetiredProvidersAtTheEnd
methods.description: Verifies that retired providers appear at the end when includeRetired is true.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldReturnAllProvidersIfIncludeRetiredTrue
methods.description: Checks that all providers, including retired ones, are returned when includeRetired is true.

methods.name: getProviderRole_shouldReturnTheProviderRoleIfExists
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a provider role by its ID when it exists.

methods.name: getProviderRole_shouldReturnNullIfNotExists
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned when a provider role does not exist for the given ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid_shouldReturnTheProviderRoleIfExists
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a provider role by its UUID when it exists.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNotExists
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned when a UUID does not correspond to any provider role.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldGetActiveProvidersByGivenRoles
methods.description: Checks that only active providers are retrieved for given roles.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldGetAllProvidersIncludingRetiredProvidersByGivenRoles
methods.description: Verifies that all providers, including retired, are retrieved for given roles when includeRetired is true.
